note: Set B is better because it extracts both x2 and x3 coordinates for the structural points, which are necessary to define locations on the 2D cross-section plot, whereas Set A only extracts x3 coordinates. Set A incorrectly claims the x3 coordinate is 0.0 m for the Mass and Geometric Centers, which are visibly offset above the axis in the image, while Set B correctly identifies a non-zero offset for the Geometric Center. Both sets miss the 'Carbon UD' material clearly listed in the legend bar.
remarks: Both sets fail to extract the 'Carbon UD' material from the legend. Set A's omission of all x2 coordinates is a significant missing fact for a 2D plot.
